'''Souse-mustard''' was used by the [[Tac-Spec Corporation|Tac-Spec]] [[Fidelis]] as a sidedish for his [[Crêpes Malreaux|Crepes Malreaux]] when he served it to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] and [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy|Scout]] aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Nighthawk]]''.

He made it using an old [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] recipe.
